errors.text: The proposed intervention is a generic workflow rather than the specific replacement of liquid-phase EAM by an MTP and thermodynamic integration by free-energy perturbation.
No mechanism is given for obtaining ab initio-accurate solid and liquid Gibbs free energies or accelerating their convergence.
The hypothesis omits essential physical contributions, including electronic excitations and solid-state short-range order.
The cited evidence concerns CALPHAD-guided alloy discovery and strengthening, not melting free energies or MTP-FEP accuracy.
The falsification benchmark lacks quantitative accuracy, cost, and convergence thresholds.
